assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one wide panoramic landscape background asset for a small monochrome e-ink game display. Use the supplied portrait image ONLY as the visual reference for its grayscale cloudy sky, delicate photographic grain, dramatic light, thin grassy horizon and dark earth cross-section. Recompose as a wide 3:1 landscape panorama, with the cloudy sky occupying about 72 percent of the height, a level thin grassy horizon at 72 percent, and textured charcoal earth below fading toward black at the bottom. The sky should be pale silver gray with layered soft clouds, enough contrast to retain detail at small display size. Keep the entire horizon clear and usable for placing separate black silhouettes later. Render only the environment. Absolutely no people, no babies, no birds, no animals, no figures, no buildings, no letters, no text, no logo, no watermark. Full bleed rectangular opaque background.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one separate transparent PNG game overlay for a monochrome e-ink life-story display. Match the naturalistic pure-black side-profile silhouettes in the supplied reference. Solid opaque black silhouette with clean contours and subtle organic edge detail; strong readability at very small sizes. Full subject entirely in frame, facing and moving toward the RIGHT. Centered on a square transparent canvas with generous clear margins, fill around 75 percent of canvas, lowest point near 90 percent height. All space surrounding and between limbs/parts must have genuine alpha transparency. No ground, no grass, no scenery, no cast shadow, no border, no lettering, no captions, no watermark, no gray rectangle. Only ONE requested subject/group. Subject: A long-necked crane bird flying toward the right in side profile, long pointed beak holding the tied corner of a soft cloth bundle with a tiny baby safely nestled inside. Extended wings in an elegant upward beat, distinct long legs trailing behind. Recognizable classic bird-delivering-a-baby silhouette. Bird and baby bundle together form a single cohesive cutout.
